title: Additivity of the Chern class, Chern character and Chern polynomials along a distinguished triangle of perfect objects
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The lemma establishes the additivity of the total Chern class, the Chern character and the Chern polynomials along a distinguished triangle of perfect objects under any of four increasingly weak hypotheses on X, from the existence of a representing map of complexes after an envelope up to quasi-compactness of X (statement lines 9426-9448, tag 0F9F). The proof must first see that the cone of the representing map is again a locally bounded complex of finite locally free modules, which is what makes all three classes defined, then reduce to a connected component so that the multiplicativity lemma applies, and finally show that the weaker hypotheses imply the first by finding an envelope over which resolutions exist. The reduction through the hypotheses is the substance, so the claim is H2.
